scope: Add a version-1 native opponent-selection UI bridge and a recording ID dataset on native leaderboard rows. The bridge reads the current UI selection, validates track/account context and up to ten requested ghost selections, then calls the existing opponent-selection callback and updates row selected classes. No simulation, replay decoding, physics, timing, scoring, authentication, track or verifier-limit behavior changed.
reviewMethod: Remove the two exact UTF-8/LF UI insertions and require byte equality with the previously pinned HEAD bundle. Snapshot all engine assets and track pins; only main.bundle.js may differ. Reuse geometry rows exactly, changing engineDigest metadata only.
